headline.title: MedQA: Fine-Tuning a Clinical AI on AMD ROCm — No CUDA Required
headline.summary: Researchers have developed MedQA, a clinical AI model fine-tuned for use with AMD's ROCm platform, eliminating the need for CUDA. This advancement aims to enhance accessibility and performance in medical AI applications.

articles.title: Musk v. Altman Evidence Shows What Microsoft Executives Thought of OpenAI
articles.summary: Emails from 2018 reveal that Microsoft executives were skeptical about OpenAI's potential but were concerned about the possibility of losing it to Amazon. This internal communication highlights the strategic considerations Microsoft faced in its relationship with OpenAI.

articles.title: Scaling Trusted Access for Cyber with GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber to enhance its Trusted Access for Cyber initiative, aimed at assisting verified defenders in accelerating vulnerability research. This expansion is designed to bolster the protection of critical infrastructure against cyber threats.

articles.title: SpaceX has a $55 billion plan to build AI chips in Texas
articles.summary: SpaceX is set to invest at least $55 billion to establish a chip manufacturing plant called "Terafab" in Austin, Texas, as reported by the New York Times and CNBC. This initiative marks Elon Musk's entry into the AI chip manufacturing sector.

articles.title: Mozilla says 271 vulnerabilities found by Mythos have "almost no false positives"
articles.summary: Mozilla has reported that 271 vulnerabilities identified by the AI tool Mythos have "almost no false positives." The company has fully embraced AI-assisted bug discovery to enhance its security efforts for Firefox.

articles.title: Pro$^2$Assist: Continuous Step-Aware Proactive Assistance with Multimodal Egocentric Perception for Long-Horizon Procedural Tasks
articles.summary: Pro$^2$Assist is a new system designed to provide continuous, proactive assistance for long-horizon procedural tasks using multimodal egocentric perception. Unlike existing personal assistants that mainly offer reactive guidance, Pro$^2$Assist aims to support users throughout complex, multi-step activities.

articles.title: Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 in the Era of Coding Agents
articles.summary: A new study evaluates a coding-agent system for ARC-AGI-3 that utilizes an executable Python world model to enhance its decision-making process. The agent verifies and refines its model based on past observations, employing a structured approach to planning and execution.

articles.title: A Regulatory Governance Framework for AI-Driven Financial Fraud Detection in U.S. Banking: Integrating OCC, SR 11-7, CFPB, and FinCEN Compliance Requirements for Model Development, Validation, and Monitoring Lifecycles
articles.summary: The article discusses the challenges U.S. financial institutions encounter in complying with multiple regulatory frameworks for AI-driven fraud detection, including OCC, SR 11-7, CFPB, and FinCEN requirements. It proposes a Regulatory Governance Framework to integrate these compliance mandates into a cohesive lifecycle for model development, validation, and monitoring.

articles.title: Resilient AI Supercomputer Networking using MRC and SRv6
articles.summary: A new research paper introduces a resilient AI supercomputer networking approach that combines a novel RDMA-based transport protocol, MRC, with multi-plane Clos topologies to enhance performance during large-scale synchronous pretraining jobs. This method aims to reduce tail latency and improve load balancing across multiple paths, enabling efficient operation for training clusters exceeding 100,000 GPUs.

articles.title: StableI2I: Spotting Unintended Changes in Image-to-Image Transition
articles.summary: The article introduces StableI2I, a new evaluation framework designed to assess image-to-image (I2I) transitions by measuring the preservation of semantic correspondence and spatial structure in generated images. This framework aims to fill the gap in existing evaluations that primarily focus on instruction adherence and aesthetic quality.

articles.title: Ilov3Splat: Instance-Level Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding in Gaussian Splatting
articles.summary: Ilov3Splat is a new framework for instance-level open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding that utilizes 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) to enhance cross-view consistency and coherent instance-level reasoning. The approach aims to improve precision in downstream 3D tasks by jointly optimizing scene geometry and semantics, overcoming limitations found in previous methods that relied on 2D rendering and point-level associations.

articles.title: RaguTeam at SemEval-2026 Task 8: Meno and Friends in a Judge-Orchestrated LLM Ensemble for Faithful Multi-Turn Response Generation
articles.summary: The RaguTeam secured first place in SemEval-2026 Task 8 with their innovative system for multi-turn response generation, utilizing a heterogeneous ensemble of seven large language models (LLMs) and a GPT-4o-mini judge for candidate selection. Their approach achieved a conditioned harmonic mean score of 0.7827, significantly surpassing the strongest baseline score of 0.6390.
